name: Photo montage hook
technique: A fast montage of property photographs cut every ~0.18 s (each with a short push-in), a plate-number counter that ticks on every cut, and a bold line that is already on frame 0; the last photo lands and holds. Photos are shown untouched.
notes: Default photos are the app's DEMO listing images (AI-generated). Replace with real, cleared property photos for paid campaigns. The headline must not state a listing count without a data source.
